NARM.name: North American Reciprocal Museum Association
NARM.notes: Distance exclusion varies by institution; many apply ~90mi. Encode per-institution overrides if found.

ROAM.name: Reciprocal Organization of Associated Museums
ROAM.notes: 100-mile exclusion measured from both residence and home institution.

MARP.name: Museum Alliance Reciprocal Program
MARP.notes: Smaller network similar to NARM/ROAM, full free admission. Required for SFMOMA. Verify current distance exclusion and encode per-institution if present.

ASTC.name: ASTC Travel Passport Program
ASTC.notes: Strict 90mi linear-radius rule from BOTH residence and home institution. Excludes most local science centers for a local user.

AZA.name: Association of Zoos and Aquariums Reciprocal Admissions Program
AZA.notes: Many facilities only 50% off, not free. Uses a numeric reciprocity-code chart; encode per-facility reciprocity_type where determinable.

AHS.name: American Horticultural Society Reciprocal Admissions Program
AHS.notes: Gardens. Free or discounted; own mileage rules. Find-a-Garden map plus PDF.

ACM.name: Association of Children's Museums Reciprocal Network
ACM.notes: 50% off general admission, up to 6 people, cardholder must be present.

TIME_TRAVELERS.name: Time Travelers
TIME_TRAVELERS.notes: History sites. Not all offer free admission; some discount only.
